sources.snippet: To address these challenges, we propose DualSwinFusionSeg, a multimodal segmentation model that separates modality-specific feature extraction and performs multi-scale cross-modal fusion. The model employs two parallel Swin Transformers to independently process RGB and auxiliary geophysical inputs, producing hierarchical feature representations.
